title: Policy
description: An alerting policy that connects health rule violations and events to automated response actions.

id.description: The internal numeric identifier for the policy.

enabled.description: Whether the policy is currently enabled.

actions.description: The list of action references triggered by this policy.

actionName.description: The name of the referenced action.

actionType.description: The type of the referenced action.

events.description: The event filter configuration defining which events trigger this policy.

selectedEntityType.description: The type of entity this policy applies to.
